test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is correct about the clutch used in vehicles?

options.text: It allows the driver to lift and unload the bulk material from engine and transmission.
It allows the driver to change the speed of engine.
It allows the driver to couple or decouple the power transmission at will without stopping the engine.
It allows the driver to change the drive of engine in any direction.

solution:
The correct answer is __It allows the driver to couple or decouple the power transmission at will without stopping the engine.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A clutch__ is an essential component of the vehicle's powertrain system.
 
• It enables the engagement or disengagement of power transmission from the engine to the gearbox.
 
• This functionality allows the driver to change gears smoothly without stopping the engine.
 
• It also helps in starting or stopping the vehicle without stalling.
 
• The clutch ensures better control of vehicle speed and torque distribution.
 
• Modern vehicles typically use friction clutches, which are more efficient and reliable.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Types of Clutches:**

 
 
• Single-plate clutch: Commonly used in light vehicles like cars and bikes.
 
• Multi-plate clutch: Used in heavy vehicles and racing cars for better torque transmission.
 
• Centrifugal clutch: Automatically operates based on engine speed, commonly used in scooters.
 
 
 
• **Importance of a Clutch:**
 
 
• Prevents engine stalling when the vehicle is stationary.
 
• Allows smooth gear shifting for a comfortable driving experience.
 
• Helps in controlling the vehicle during uphill or downhill drives.
